svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint's software catalog: 15 nodes, 16 connections. 15 entities of a Backstage catalog, framed by 3 systems and the domains that hold them. An arrow says a component provides or consumes an API, or depends on another entity.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-13tziqqrz5, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint's software catalog
svg.desc: Parcelpoint's software catalog: 15 nodes, 16 connections. 15 entities of a Backstage catalog, framed by 3 systems and the domains that hold them. An arrow says a component provides or consumes an API, or depends on another entity. Nodes: - Resource group: Parcel delivery (Domain, owned by engineering) - Application tier: Tracking (System, owned by team-tracking) - Tracking API (Service, owned by team-tracking), service - Carrier event worker (Service, owned by team-tracking), service - Tracking REST API (OpenAPI API, owned by team-tracking), gateway - Parcel events (AsyncAPI API, owned by team-tracking), gateway - Tracking database (Postgres) (Resource, database, owned by team-tracking), database - Carrier events (RabbitMQ) (Resource, queue, owned by team-tracking), queue - Application tier: Label printing (System, owned by team-labels) - Label intake (Service, owned by team-labels), service - Label renderer (Service, owned by team-labels), service - Label requests (OpenAPI API, owned by team-labels), gateway - Label requests (Amazon SQS) (Resource, queue, owned by team-labels), queue - Label jobs (DynamoDB) (Resource, database, owned by team-labels), database - Label PDFs (Amazon S3) (Resource, s3-bucket, owned by team-labels), storage - Application tier: Merchant integrations (System, owned by team-integrations) - Merchant dashboard (Website, owned by team-integrations), client - Webhook sender (Service, owned by team-integrations), service - Node SDK (Library, experimental, owned by team-integrations), service Connections: - Merchant dashboard to Tracking REST API: consumes - Webhook sender to Parcel events: consumes - Node SDK to Tracking REST API: consumes - Label intake to Label requests: provides - Label intake to Label requests (Amazon SQS): depends on - Label intake to Label jobs (DynamoDB): depends on - Label renderer to Label requests (Amazon SQS): depends on - Label renderer to Label jobs (DynamoDB): depends on - Label renderer to Label PDFs (Amazon S3): depends on - Tracking API to Tracking REST API: provides - Tracking API to Label requests: consumes - Tracking API to Tracking database (Postgres): depends on - Tracking API to Carrier events (RabbitMQ): depends on - Carrier event worker to Parcel events: provides - Carrier event worker to Tracking database (Postgres): depends on - Carrier event worker to Carrier events (RabbitMQ): depends on
